ballotMeasures.title: 2026 Midterm · North Carolina Constitutional Amendment - Require Photo ID for Voting
ballotMeasures.summary:
Constitutional amendment to require all voters, not just those presenting to vote in person, to present photo identification before voting.

In short: Would amend the state constitution so that the existing photo ID requirement for in-person voting also applies to voters using other methods, such as absentee by mail.

Official ballot language. Source: https://s3.amazonaws.com/dl.ncsbe.gov/Elections/2026/Candidate%20Filing/statewide_referendums_20261103.pdf

ballotMeasures.title: 2026 Midterm · North Carolina Constitutional Amendment - Maximum Income Tax Rate of 3.5%
ballotMeasures.summary:
Constitutional amendment to keep the State income tax rate from being raised higher than three and one-half percent (3.5%).

In short: Would lower the maximum State income tax rate allowed by the constitution from 7% to 3.5%, applying to taxable years beginning on or after January 1, 2027.

Official ballot language. Source: https://s3.amazonaws.com/dl.ncsbe.gov/Elections/2026/Candidate%20Filing/statewide_referendums_20261103.pdf

ballotMeasures.title: 2026 Midterm · North Carolina Constitutional Amendment - Property Tax Levy Limit
ballotMeasures.summary:
Constitutional amendment requiring limits on property tax increases by local governments.

In short: Would direct the General Assembly to enact general laws limiting how much local property tax levies may increase, with the specific limits set by later legislation.

Official ballot language. Source: https://s3.amazonaws.com/dl.ncsbe.gov/Elections/2026/Candidate%20Filing/statewide_referendums_20261103.pdf
